from pathlib import Path
from math import log, exp, isfinite
rows=[]
for line in Path('/app/graphene.dat').read_text().splitlines():
 if line.strip():
  a,b=line.split('\t'); rows.append((float(a.replace(',','.')),float(b.replace(',','.'))))

# Least-squares offset + amplitude for fixed x0,gamma, normalized Lorentzian.
def fit_fixed(data,x0,gamma):
    z=[1.0/(1.0+((x-x0)/gamma)**2) for x,y in data]
    n=len(data); sz=sum(z); sy=sum(y for x,y in data); szz=sum(v*v for v in z); szy=sum(v*y for v,(x,y) in zip(z,data))
    det=n*szz-sz*sz
    if det <= 1e-20: return (float('inf'),0,0)
    amp=(n*szy-sz*sy)/det
    off=(sy-amp*sz)/n
    sse=sum((y-(off+amp*v))**2 for v,(x,y) in zip(z,data))
    return sse,amp,off

def objective(data,x0,lg): return fit_fixed(data,x0,exp(lg))[0]

def nm(data,x0,gamma, maxit=1000):
    # variables x0, log gamma, with initial simplex scaled
    p=[(x0,log(gamma)),(x0+max(1,gamma*.1),log(gamma)),(x0,log(gamma*1.1))]
    vals=[objective(data,*q) for q in p]
    for it in range(maxit):
      order=sorted(range(3),key=lambda i: vals[i]); p=[p[i] for i in order]; vals=[vals[i] for i in order]
      if max(abs(p[i][0]-p[0][0])+abs(p[i][1]-p[0][1])*max(1,gamma) for i in [1,2]) < 1e-8: break
      # centroid best & second
      cx=(p[0][0]+p[1][0])/2; cy=(p[0][1]+p[1][1])/2
      # reflect
      r=(cx+(cx-p[2][0]), cy+(cy-p[2][1])); vr=objective(data,*r)
      if vals[0] <= vr < vals[1]: p[2],vals[2]=r,vr
      elif vr < vals[0]:
        e=(cx+2*(r[0]-cx),cy+2*(r[1]-cy)); ve=objective(data,*e)
        p[2],vals[2]=(e,ve) if ve<vr else (r,vr)
      else:
        c=(cx+.5*(p[2][0]-cx),cy+.5*(p[2][1]-cy)); vc=objective(data,*c)
        if vc<vals[2]: p[2],vals[2]=c,vc
        else:
          p[1]=(p[0][0]+.5*(p[1][0]-p[0][0]),p[0][1]+.5*(p[1][1]-p[0][1]))
          p[2]=(p[0][0]+.5*(p[2][0]-p[0][0]),p[0][1]+.5*(p[2][1]-p[0][1]))
          vals[1]=objective(data,*p[1]); vals[2]=objective(data,*p[2])
    i=min(range(3),key=lambda i: vals[i]); q=p[i]; sse,amp,off=fit_fixed(data,q[0],exp(q[1]))
    return q[0],exp(q[1]),amp,off,sse,it

def run(lo,hi,starts):
 data=[r for r in rows if lo<=r[0]<=hi]
 print('\nWINDOW',lo,hi,'n',len(data),'xrange', (min(x for x,y in data),max(x for x,y in data)))
 out=[]
 for x0,g in starts:
  q=nm(data,x0,g)
  out.append(q)
  print('start',x0,g,'=> x0 %.6f gamma %.6f amp %.6f off %.6f rmse %.6f it %d'%(q[0],q[1],q[2],q[3],(q[4]/len(data))**.5,q[5]))

for lo,hi,center in [(15500,17000,16250),(16800,18000,17500),(16500,18000,17200),(18500,20000,19200),(18000,20000,19200),(15000,18000,16500)]:
 starts=[]
 for g in [20,50,100,200,400,800]:
  for dx in [-300,-100,0,100,300]: starts.append((center+dx,g))
 run(lo,hi,starts)
